projects.title: Reqruit IQ — AI Talent Intelligence Platform
projects.tagline: Intelligent candidate evaluation & automated matching with ongoing research paper
projects.description: An AI-driven recruitment and talent screening ecosystem engineered to analyze multi-format resumes, score domain competencies, and match candidates against role criteria using semantic vector representations. Currently paired with an ongoing research paper examining algorithmic fairness, semantic relevance, and ranking optimizations in automated hiring pipelines.
keyFeatures: Automated multi-format resume ingestion, entity extraction, and skill graph mapping
Semantic candidate-to-job matching algorithms yielding granular qualification indices
Ongoing research paper: "Algorithmic Fairness and Semantic Relevance in Automated Candidate Resume Retrieval"
Asynchronous evaluation pipeline with FastAPI microservices for sub-second scoring
Interactive recruiter portal featuring customizable scoring weights and bias-mitigated screening
projects.architectureNotes: FastAPI microservices pipeline extracting text embeddings and computing weighted cosine similarities, backed by PostgreSQL for applicant records and React.js for the review interface.

researchPaper.topic: Algorithmic Fairness and Semantic Relevance in Automated Candidate Resume Retrieval

projects.title: InsightU – Smart Academic Collaboration Platform
projects.tagline: High-concurrency academic platform handling 1,000+ requests with 40% latency reduction
projects.description: A modern academic ecosystem engineered for university environments. Features high-concurrency state synchronization, automated quiz generation, dynamic timetable mapping, and collaborative lecture note feeds.
keyFeatures: Engineered high-concurrency architecture handling 1,000+ concurrent simulated requests
Integrated Redis caching layer for hot database queries, achieving 40% reduction in average API latency under load
Implemented secure authentication using JWT with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) across student and faculty routes
Designed dynamic collaborative tools including live canvas synchronization, automated quiz generation, and responsive schedule management
projects.architectureNotes: React 18 frontend communicating with an asynchronous FastAPI/Express backend, utilizing Redis for real-time state caching and PostgreSQL with Prisma for ACID persistence.

projects.title: Datara (ChronoSearch) – Information Retrieval System
projects.tagline: Time-aware full-text search engine accelerating queries by 30% across 100k+ records
projects.description: A scalable full-text and semantic information retrieval engine utilizing the Whoosh indexing engine for dynamic CSV ingestion, temporal range querying, and high-throughput document parsing.
keyFeatures: Architected scalable full-text and semantic information retrieval engine utilizing the Whoosh indexing engine
Optimized multi-field inverted index queries, accelerating structured dataset search speeds by 30% across 100k+ records
Developed asynchronous RESTful endpoints via FastAPI for real-time document parsing, dynamic metadata extraction, and indexing
projects.architectureNotes: Custom inverted index constructed via Whoosh Engine coupled with FastAPI async endpoints and Pandas vectorized preprocessing.

projects.title: Adaptive Study Twin – AI Personalization Engine
projects.tagline: AI diagnostic assessment engine identifying learner weakness vectors with 88% accuracy
projects.description: An AI-assisted adaptive learning platform that dynamically tailors evaluation difficulty and content pathways based on historical performance metrics.
keyFeatures: Built an AI-assisted adaptive learning platform dynamically tailoring evaluation difficulty based on performance metrics
Engineered diagnostic assessment algorithms using Scikit-learn identifying learner weakness vectors with 88% classification accuracy
Structured modular REST services in FastAPI to support future integration of vector embeddings and LLM inference pipelines
projects.architectureNotes: Scikit-learn classification pipelines trained on evaluation outcomes, exposed via FastAPI REST endpoints to a React/Tailwind user interface.

projects.title: Online Examination System
projects.tagline: Secure assessment platform handling 500+ concurrent submissions with zero data loss
projects.description: A secure assessment platform executing automated evaluation and timer-controlled state handling for online testing, backed by optimized relational schemas.
keyFeatures: Developed secure assessment platform executing automated evaluation and timer-controlled state handling for online testing
Optimized relational schema and index structures in MySQL to handle 500+ concurrent examination submissions with zero data loss
Incorporated secure candidate session tracking and automated grading modules
